description: Search Reddit by keyword, across all of Reddit or inside chosen subreddits, read the newest posts of subreddits, or read thread URLs with their comments. Returns one flat row per post (title, text, author, subreddit, publish date, post link, outbound link, the search term it matched) and, when asked, one row per comment, plus one free summary row per query. By default a search result is kept only when the search term is in its title or text. Reads Reddit's public feeds; no Reddit login or API key. A run that does not succeed is returned as an error with its run ID. Read-only; requires an APIFY_TOKEN and is billed per post and comment row.

comment_depth.description: Reply levels under each top level comment. Default 3.

include_comments.description: Also return the comments of every post found. Default false. Thread URLs always return comments.

max_charge_usd.description: Optional. The run stops before a charge that would pass this amount.

max_comments_per_thread.description: Comments per thread, top first. Default 25.

max_posts_per_query.description: Posts per search or subreddit. Default 50.

only_new.description: Skip posts and comments an earlier run returned for the same query (free). Default false.

proxy_mode.description: auto uses the Apify proxy pool with residential as the fallback; residential uses residential addresses for every request. Does not change the price. Default auto.

require_term_match.description: Keep a search result only when the term is in its title or text. Default true.

search_terms.description: Keywords to search Reddit for. With subreddits, each term runs inside each subreddit; without, across all of Reddit.

since_days.description: Drop posts older than this many days.

state_key.description: Optional name for the only new results memory.

subreddit_sort.description: Order for subreddit reads with no search term. Default new.

subreddits.description: Subreddit names (sales, r/sales, or a URL). With search terms, the search runs inside them; without, their newest posts are read.

thread_urls.description: Reddit thread URLs to read with their comments, up to 200.

time_window.description: Reddit's time filter for searches and the top sort. Default month.

name: search_reddit
title: Search Reddit posts and comments
